LESSON: DIVISION

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: MATHEMATICS
Strand: Numbers
Topic 1.5: Division
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 8

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Division, part of Numbers in Grade 4 MATHEMATICS.

Key inquiry question: When can you use division in real life?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. discuss and carry out the division of up to a two-digit number by a one-digit number without remainder using number cards or other resources,

2. jointly with peers, carry out division of up to a two-digit number by a one-digit number with remainder and prepare division charts,

3. jointly with peers carry out division of up to a three-digit number by 100

4. team up with peers to carry out division and multiplication of the same numbers to establish a relationship between multiplication and division,

5. jointly with peers, play games involving division using digital devices.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. discuss and carry out the division of up to a two-digit number by a one-digit number without remainder using number cards or other resources,
2. jointly with peers, carry out division of up to a two-digit number by a one-digit number with remainder and prepare division charts,
3. jointly with peers carry out division of up to a three-digit number by 100
4. team up with peers to carry out division and multiplication of the same numbers to establish a relationship between multiplication and division,
5. jointly with peers, play games involving division using digital devices.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Division together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Learning to learn: learner carries out division and multiplication of same numbers in group to establish relationship between

multiplication and division.

Digital literacy: learner, jointly with peers, plays games involving division using digital device.

Values:
Love: learner respects others group members opinions while carrying out division and multiplication of same numbers to

establish relationship between multiplication and division.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Peer Education: learner contributes in group discussions on establishing relationship between multiplication and

division.

Link to other subjects

The learner is able to relate the concept of division to concept of mixtures in Science and Technology.
